scientific limitations/integrity: The new contribution is the explicit correction and all-parameter synthesis for complete multipartite mixed metric dimension. Constituent complete-bipartite, edge-dimension, and universal-vertex results are prior literature. An elementary proof and an exact exhaustive check on all 58 multipartite types of orders 2 through 8 support correctness. Literature absence is best-of-knowledge; no independent audit or expert validation has been performed.
title: Corrected mixed metric dimension of complete multipartite graphs
